notes_for_editor: Thin record. The three source pages give no staffing, fire or removal-date history, and two web searches found none for this site. The Oregon list has only a status line and a township-and-range location here. Idaho's Hemlock Butte (Clearwater NF) appeared in search results and was excluded as a different site. No source gives an access level, so access and visit are left unset. Register elevation 6,301 ft (1,921 m) matches the brief's 1920.5 m, so no correction. Elevation has no facts key in the schema, so it is recorded only in the story. The register's nominator name is left out.
